run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# PostgreSQL 17 与 MySQL 8.4 的 JSON 索引对比：索引类型、可加速运算符与索引代价 本次核验的资料显示，两者都能为 JSON 查询提供专用索引加速，但覆盖面与代价不同：MySQL 8.4 的多值索引可优化在 WHERE 子句中使用 JSON_OVERLAPS() 的 JSON 列查询，但由于同一聚簇索引记录的索引记录分散存放，不支持范围扫描和索引覆盖扫描；PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类仅支持 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符的查询，但通常比 jsonb_ops 索引小得多且搜索特异度更好，此外对不适合 GIN 使用的 JSON 数据，B-tree 表达式索引也可提供帮助。 ## 直接回答 在 JSON 索引类型方面，本次核验的资料显示，MySQL 8.4 可为 JSON 列查询使用多值索引（multi-valued indexes），且这类索引可优化在 WHERE 子句中使用 JSON_OVERLAPS() 的查询。PostgreSQL 17 方面，资料提到 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类与默认的 jsonb_ops 操作符类，并指出对某些不利于 GIN 使用场景的 JSON 数据，创建典型的 B-tree 表达式索引也能提供帮助。 [evidence:0437ed37e80600726ec30f9dc0086944137499149dcc6028] [evidence:314dbdd6bc00e74dd3d584353538df5ea1b10c77883ba6a5] [evidence:fc1656b645bed5a59c1036912d70854c9bf8e2ae130a4a25] 在可加速的查询运算符方面，本次核验的资料显示，MySQL 8.4 的多值索引优化针对在 WHERE 子句中使用 JSON_OVERLAPS() 的 JSON 列查询；PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_path_ops 操作符类仅支持 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符的查询，同时资料指出该操作符类相较默认的 jsonb_ops 具有显著性能优势。 [evidence:9076c3a88f50ce092516392d5346dfacf0917f733e9be891] [evidence:314dbdd6bc00e74dd3d584353538df5ea1b10c77883ba6a5] 在索引代价方面，本次核验的资料显示，MySQL 8.4 的多值索引由于同一聚簇索引记录的索引记录分散存放，不支持范围扫描和索引覆盖扫描；PostgreSQL 17 的 jsonb_path_ops 索引通常比覆盖相同数据的 jsonb_ops 索引小得多，且搜索特异度更好。 [evidence:63f2bb0bb6b2353c94df2575aa3f4e24df6c3304f5a65210] [evidence:cee8a710812f34a91696d5a2e8dd62783d40fd3a739c0e77] ## 对比表 | 产品 | JSON 索引类型 | 可加速的查询运算符 | 索引代价特征 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | MySQL 8.4 | 多值索引（multi-valued indexes） | WHERE 子句中使用 JSON_OVERLAPS() 的 JSON 列查询 | 同一聚簇索引记录的索引记录分散存放，不支持范围扫描和索引覆盖扫描 [evidence:0437ed37e80600726ec30f9dc0086944137499149dcc6028] [evidence:9076c3a88f50ce092516392d5346dfacf0917f733e9be891] [evidence:63f2bb0bb6b2353c94df2575aa3f4e24df6c3304f5a65210] | | PostgreSQL 17 | jsonb_path_ops 操作符类（相较默认 jsonb_ops）；对不适合 GIN 场景的 JSON 数据可用典型 B-tree 表达式索引 | jsonb_path_ops 仅支持 @>、@? 和 @@ 运算符 | jsonb_path_ops 索引通常比相同数据的 jsonb_ops 索引小得多，搜索特异度更好 [evidence:fc1656b645bed5a59c1036912d70854c9bf8e2ae130a4a25] [evidence:314dbdd6bc00e74dd3d584353538df5ea1b10c77883ba6a5] [evidence:cee8a710812f34a91696d5a2e8dd62783d40fd3a739c0e77] | ## Citation audit ### MySQL 8.4 · Accelerated operators - Evidence: `evidence:9076c3a88f50ce092516392d5346dfacf0917f733e9be891` - Exact quote: “Queries on JSON columns of [`InnoDB`](innodb-storage-engine.html "Chapter 17 The InnoDB Storage Engine")
tables using `JSON_OVERLAPS()` in the” - Snapshot: `research/external/f77dcbf1-0cff-4804-8f21-37ef6f9c19ac/5f05107e0cd5c6134d14b52277f6fd9e4b45110e48ebf4476e5a1ea4f15303af` - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/json-search-functions.html ### MySQL 8.4 · JSON index types - Evidence: `evidence:0437ed37e80600726ec30f9dc0086944137499149dcc6028` - Exact quote: “Queries on JSON columns of [`InnoDB`](innodb-storage-engine.html "Chapter 17 The InnoDB Storage Engine")
tables using `JSON_OVERLAPS()` in the
`WHERE` clause can be optimized using
multi-valued indexes.” - Snapshot: `research/external/7c9c506c-e53a-4ad2-aa1a-ae38157666a1/4547e83ec1f6922b0b5e568b6d6dd54bdfa497aea0c497eb7b83e660b7f4be04` - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.4/en/json-search-functions.html ### MySQL 8.4 · Index cost characteristics - Evidence: `evidence:63f2bb0bb6b2353c94df2575aa3f4e24df6c3304f5a65210` - Exact quote: “Because index records for the same clustered index record
are dispersed throughout a multi-valued index, a
multi-valued index does not support range scans or
index-only scans.” - Snapshot: `research/external/6a6cb107-2c56-4686-8408-3d768f8e30aa/fce2d5748ac630bef49b0fadc3b9f351157c3a7d6bce49aee9e414769fe12d80` - URL: https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/9.3/en/create-index.html ### PostgreSQL 17 · Accelerated operators - Evidence: `evidence:314dbdd6bc00e74dd3d584353538df5ea1b10c77883ba6a5` - Exact quote: “Although the `jsonb_path_ops` operator class supports only queries with the `@>`, `@?` and `@@` operators, it has notable performance advantages over the default operator class `jsonb_ops`.” - Snapshot: `research/external/e209e325-f3e0-42e8-a4b0-58f5969b0a01/07884102172409b1463870d1ffda919c9f324578588ecf3946303382d8a85350` - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html ### PostgreSQL 17 · JSON index types - Evidence: `evidence:fc1656b645bed5a59c1036912d70854c9bf8e2ae130a4a25` - Exact quote: “For some cases, creating a typical B-tree expression index can help with JSON that doesn’t fit the GIN use cases.” - Snapshot: `research/external/8d270b60-eff5-4742-8bfc-99c34054bf9e/c234aa55f0842fd6ea1d6b4396b6e30d36be5cc371313720459750acca224bd5` - URL: https://www.crunchydata.com/blog/indexing-jsonb-in-postgres ### PostgreSQL 17 · Index cost characteristics - Evidence: `evidence:cee8a710812f34a91696d5a2e8dd62783d40fd3a739c0e77` - Exact quote: “A `jsonb_path_ops` index is usually much smaller than a `jsonb_ops` index over the same data, and the specificity of searches is better” - Snapshot: `research/external/e209e325-f3e0-42e8-a4b0-58f5969b0a01/07884102172409b1463870d1ffda919c9f324578588ecf3946303382d8a85350` - URL: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html
